scope: Spain. Headline 'Spain' values = Peninsula + Balearics (area-weighted); Canarias separate
method: Theil–Sen slope (Gilbert 95% CI) + Mann–Kendall (ties-corrected; Hamed–Rao if lag-1 autocorrelation is significant). significant = p < 0.05 and CI excludes 0. Maps show slopes; per-cell q (Benjamini–Hochberg) in cell_q_value. No extrapolation.

merra2.note: Reanalysis (model with data assimilation), not a direct observation

seasonal_mann_kendall_monthly.method: Seasonal Mann-Kendall (Hirsch 1982) + seasonal Sen slope, 12 calendar months

gpm.spi_definition: Standardized annual precipitation anomaly: (annual total − 2000–2024 cell mean) / cell SD. A z-score, NOT the gamma-fitted SPI

gldas.dataset: NASA GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 monthly 0.25° v2.1
gldas.coverage: 2000–2025 complete years, Peninsula + Balearics area-weighted mean of the 0.25° grid
gldas.note: Land-surface model output. Runoff is modelled water leaving the soil column, not measured river discharge

noaa.coverage: 2001–2025, station-years with >= 330 valid days per variable; not homogenized
noaa.trend_rule: station trend needs >= 15 complete years; q = Benjamini–Hochberg across stations per metric
